limitations: Every executable file-backed E8/E9 rel32 byte candidate to this target is retained, including candidates not proved to start an instruction.
Actual instruction confirmation requires a retained CALL/JMP boundary, correct operand width/length and original PE byte agreement.
Supplemental bounded disassembly/toggle/native carriers are recorded separately; the original 647 graph ranges are never extended.
Old typed xrefs and caller headers retain their original evidence class and do not alone supply a complete retained source-body Listing.
No nearest-function guess is made for graph-external or unresolved candidates; no callee expansion, business parameter inference or runtime behavior is asserted.

source_scope: Complete retained records/declared address sets and selected rule clauses. No assertion of all callback paths, parameter flow or runtime activation.
